title: "Resources"

## Statistical intuition (interactive)

- [Seeing Theory](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu): [probability](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/basic-probability/index.html) and [distributions](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/probability-distributions/index.html) (S4), [inference](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/frequentist-inference/index.html) (S5–S6), [regression](https://seeing-theory.brown.edu/regression-analysis/index.html) (S7)
- R Psychologist: [CIs](https://rpsychologist.com/d3/CI/), [power](https://rpsychologist.com/d3/NHST/), [p-values](https://rpsychologist.com/pvalue/), [Cohen's d](https://rpsychologist.com/cohend/), [correlation](https://rpsychologist.com/correlation/)
- [StatKey](https://www.lock5stat.com/StatKey/): bootstrap and randomisation tests
- [Guess the Correlation](https://www.guessthecorrelation.com); [p-hacker](https://shinyapps.org/apps/p-hacker/); [Spurious Correlations](https://www.tylervigen.com/spurious-correlations); [Datasaurus Dozen](https://jumpingrivers.github.io/datasauRus/)

## Statistics books

- Poldrack, [*Statistical Thinking for the 21st Century*](https://statsthinking21.github.io/statsthinking21-core-site/) and its [R companion](https://statsthinking21.github.io/statsthinking21-R-site/)
- Navarro, [*Learning Statistics with R*](https://learningstatisticswithr.com)
- Lakens, [*Improving Your Statistical Inferences*](https://lakens.github.io/statistical_inferences/)
- Ismay, Kim, Valdivia, [*ModernDive*](https://moderndive.com)
- Lindeløv, [*Common statistical tests are linear models*](https://lindeloev.github.io/tests-as-linear/)
- Nature Methods, [*Points of Significance*](https://www.nature.com/collections/qghhqm)
- Kass, Eden, Brown, *Analysis of Neural Data* (Springer, 2014); Durstewitz, *Advanced Data Analysis in Neuroscience* (Springer, 2017)

## R, data and Quarto

- Wickham et al., [*R for Data Science* (2e)](https://r4ds.hadley.nz)
- Grolemund, [*Hands-On Programming with R*](https://rstudio-education.github.io/hopr/)
- PsyTeachR, [*Data Skills for Reproducible Research*](https://psyteachr.github.io/reprores-v4/)
- [Posit cheatsheets](https://posit.co/resources/cheatsheets/) (dplyr, ggplot2, purrr, Quarto)
- [Quarto documentation](https://quarto.org)
- Bryan, [*Happy Git and GitHub for the useR*](https://happygitwithr.com)
- Stuck? [Posit Community](https://forum.posit.co), with a minimal reproducible example

## Visualisation

- [From Data to Viz](https://www.data-to-viz.com); [R Graph Gallery](https://r-graph-gallery.com)
- Wickham et al., [*ggplot2*](https://ggplot2-book.org); Wilke, [*Fundamentals of Data Visualization*](https://clauswilke.com/dataviz/)
- Colour-blind safe palettes: [viridis](https://sjmgarnier.github.io/viridis/), [ColorBrewer](https://colorbrewer2.org)

## Reproducibility and pitfalls

- [*The Turing Way*](https://book.the-turing-way.org)
- Baker (2016). [1,500 scientists lift the lid on reproducibility](https://doi.org/10.1038/533452a). *Nature*.
- Button et al. (2013). [Power failure](https://doi.org/10.1038/nrn3475). *Nat Rev Neurosci*.
- Botvinik-Nezer et al. (2020). [Variability in the analysis of a single neuroimaging dataset by many teams](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-020-2314-9). *Nature*.
- Makin & Orban de Xivry (2019). [Ten common statistical mistakes](https://doi.org/10.7554/eLife.48175). *eLife*. **Read this one.**
- Nieuwenhuis et al. (2011). [Erroneous analyses of interactions in neuroscience](https://doi.org/10.1038/nn.2886). *Nat Neurosci*.
- Bennett et al. (2009). [The principled control of false positives in neuroimaging](https://doi.org/10.1093/scan/nsp053). *SCAN*.
- Wasserstein & Lazar (2016). [The ASA statement on p-values](https://doi.org/10.1080/00031305.2016.1154108). *Am Stat*.
- Weissgerber et al. (2015). [Beyond bar and line graphs](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pbio.1002128). *PLoS Biol*.

## Beyond this course

- **Repeated measures** (trials, sessions, recordings per subject) are not independent. Here we average or pair; the proper tool is a mixed model: [`lme4`](https://cran.r-project.org/package=lme4); Yu et al. (2022), [Beyond t test and ANOVA](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2021.10.030), *Neuron*.
- **Robust/regularised regression:** `MASS::rlm()`, `robustbase::lmrob()`, `quantreg::rq()`, `glmnet`.
- **Neuro data in R:** [Neuroconductor](https://neuroconductor.org), `RNifti`, [`eegUtils`](https://craddm.github.io/eegUtils/), [`eeguana`](https://github.com/bnicenboim/eeguana), [`ggseg`](https://github.com/ggseg/ggseg). Open data: [OpenNeuro](https://openneuro.org), [OSF](https://osf.io).
